# Scrolly — Micro-Learning, Quick Guess, Word Lab & Scrolla 1v1 (https://scrolly.live)

> Scrolly (https://scrolly.live) is a free, bilingual (English and Turkish) reels-style micro-learning platform offering scientifically verified fact cards, Quick Guess interactive challenges, Word Lab (B1–C2 English vocabulary cards with IPA pronunciation and quizzes), Memory/Daily/Weekly Quizzes, XP leaderboards, and Scrolla 1v1 real-time knowledge duels.

> Scrolly (https://scrolly.live); doğrulanmış bilimsel bilgi kartları, Hızlı Tahmin oyunu, Word Lab (B1–C2 İngilizce kelime öğrenme), Hafıza/Günlük/Haftalık Quiz modları, haftalık liderlik tablosu ve Scrolla 1v1 canlı bilgi düelloları sunan ücretsiz, iki dilli (Türkçe ve İngilizce) reels tarzı mikro-öğrenme platformudur.

## Core Pages & App Modes / Ana Sayfalar ve Modlar

- [Explore Feed (TR) / Keşfet Akışı](https://scrolly.live/): Vertical full-screen reels feed of verified science, space, nature, history, human body, records, and statistics cards with interactive Quick Guess sliders and primary source links.
- [Explore Feed (EN)](https://scrolly.live/en): Full English-language discovery feed with verified scientific citations and interactive challenges.
- [Quiz Hub / Quiz Merkezi](https://scrolly.live/?tab=quiz): Memory Quiz (built from recently viewed cards), Daily 5-Card Sprint, Weekly Marathon (10 questions), and Word Lab Vocabulary Quiz.
- [Leaderboard / Sıralama](https://scrolly.live/?tab=leaderboard): Weekly and all-time XP rankings, Explorer Leagues, and streak standings across players.
- [Scrolla 1v1 Arena](https://scrolly.live/?tab=duel): Real-time 2-player head-to-head trivia duel rooms with 6-character room codes, topic selection, synchronized countdowns, and shared fact packs.
- [About & Editorial Methodology / Hakkımızda](https://scrolly.live/about): Fact-checking workflow, primary academic source policy, bilingual editorial standards, and Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ).
- [Contact & Source Corrections / İletişim](https://scrolly.live/contact): Direct editorial feedback, scientific citation updates, and support channel (`contact@scrolly.live`).
- [Privacy Policy / Gizlilik Politikası](https://scrolly.live/privacy): Anonymous local storage, optional passwordless email OTP account sync, offline PWA caching, analytics, and Google AdSense cookie notice.
- [Terms of Use / Kullanım Koşulları](https://scrolly.live/terms): Educational disclaimer, fair-use guidelines, and service terms.

## Categories & Topic Feeds / Kategoriler ve Konu Akışları

- [Space / Uzay](https://scrolly.live/?category=space): Planets, stars, black holes, cosmology, orbital physics, and space exploration missions (NASA/ESA sourced).
- [Nature / Doğa](https://scrolly.live/?category=nature): Animal biology, ecosystems, deep oceans, botany, climate, and Earth phenomena.
- [Human Body / İnsan Vücudu](https://scrolly.live/?category=human-body): Human anatomy, neuroscience, genetics, physiology, and medical science discoveries.
- [History / Tarih](https://scrolly.live/?category=history): Ancient civilizations, archaeological discoveries, historical inventions, and pivotal world events.
- [Science / Bilim](https://scrolly.live/?category=science): Physics, chemistry, quantum mechanics, mathematics, and landmark laboratory breakthroughs.
- [Weird Records / Garip Rekorlar](https://scrolly.live/?category=weird-records): Extraordinary world records, extreme natural phenomena, and verified scientific oddities.
- [Statistics / İstatistik](https://scrolly.live/?category=statistics): Counterintuitive probabilities, global demographic trends, and data-backed numerical insights.
- [Word Lab / Dil Öğrenme (B1–C2)](https://scrolly.live/?category=vocabulary): Interactive B1–C2 English vocabulary cards featuring IPA pronunciation, Turkish definitions, bilingual context sentences, audio playback, and recall quizzes.

## Static Topic Archives & Machine-Readable Feeds / Arşivler ve Makine Okunur Akışlar

- [Full Verified Knowledge Corpus (llms-full.txt)](https://scrolly.live/llms-full.txt): Plain-text / Markdown export of verified fact cards with bilingual summaries, explanations, quiz Q&As, and source URLs.
- [XML Sitemap (sitemap.xml)](https://scrolly.live/sitemap.xml): Live index of homepage routes, topic archive pages, trust pages, and individual `/fact/[slug]` and `/en/fact/[slug]` pages.
- [Space Archive](https://scrolly.live/category/space) | [Nature Archive](https://scrolly.live/category/nature) | [Human Body Archive](https://scrolly.live/category/human-body) | [History Archive](https://scrolly.live/category/history) | [Science Archive](https://scrolly.live/category/science) | [Records Archive](https://scrolly.live/category/records) | [Statistics Archive](https://scrolly.live/category/statistics)
